meta.name: game-launch
meta.description: Invoke when the user is preparing for game release, needs a launch checklist, store submission guidance, go/no-go decision framework, or day-one patch planning. Covers Steam, itch.io, Epic, and console submission pipelines. Triggers on: "launch", "release", "store submission", "go/no-go", "day-one patch", "launch readiness". Do NOT invoke for sprint planning (use game-sprint-plan) or code review (use game-code-review). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 准备游戏发布所需的检查清单与提交流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在准备游戏发布，需要核对清单和提交流程指导。
copy.tagline_en: Prepare launch checklists and store submission guidance for game release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing for a game launch and need checklists and submission guidance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你制定游戏发布计划，包括发布检查清单、商店提交指导、是否上线决策框架和首日补丁规划。
howto.when: 当你提到“发布”、“商店提交”、“是否上线”、“首日补丁”等关键词，或要求准备游戏发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我准备 Steam 发布检查清单。
say.note: Claude 会列出 Steam 商店所需资产和步骤。

say.text: 我们该不该按计划上线？
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成是否上线决策框架。

say.text: 规划首日补丁的部署流程。
say.note: Claude 会提供补丁测试和发布建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you create a game release plan, including a launch checklist, store submission guidance, go/no-go decision framework, and day-one patch planning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "launch", "release", "store submission", "go/no-go", "day-one patch", or ask for launch preparation.

say_en.text: Help me prepare a Steam launch checklist.
say_en.note: Claude will list required assets and steps for Steam.

say_en.text: Should we go ahead with the launch?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the go/no-go framework.

say_en.text: Plan the day-one patch deployment process.
say_en.note: Claude will provide patch testing and release advice.
